rounds.text: Institutional confidence in Tankup Engineers Ltd is visibly eroding, evidenced by a sharp reduction in institutional sponsorship [E8]. Foreign institutions slashed their holdings from 1.72% in April 2025 to 0.19% by March 2026, while domestic institutions simultaneously retreated from 10.61% down to 7.29% over the exact same timeframe [E2, E3]. This combined exodus confirms a negative institutional money flow with a holding change of -0.32 percentage points [E4]. Consequently, the rules-based screen reflects this acute lack of smart-money backing by scoring a mediocre 49 out of 100, categorizing the overall setup merely as neutral with medium confidence [E7]. Conceded: promoters have maintained a steady 73.65% stake without selling down their own positions [E1]. However, this insider stability offers little comfort when professional investors are actively voting with their feet and abandoning the stock [E2, E3].
